recordings.text: A new friend! Let us keep exploring.
Take your time. I am here to help.
The pen is in the bag.
How many books do you have?
Signal confirmed. Ready for the next step!
One small clue can help. Try again.
The signal is clear now. Well done!
She is ten. He is six.
This is my brother. This is my mother.
That was lovely. Our story goes on!
Let us look at the clue together.
You tried again, and it worked!
This is my father. This is my family.
This is a table. This is a chair. This is a cup.
The book is on the table.
The cup is on the table.
I eat rice. I read a book. I sleep.
I read in the morning. I sleep at night.
I walk. I run. I write.
Does he run? He does not run.
I am a student. She is a teacher.
What is this? It is a pen.
I have a job. I am a teacher.
I go by train. I go by bus.
Can I have a ticket, please?
A ticket for the train, please.
This is a hotel. This is a station. This is a map.
Go straight. Turn left. Turn right.
Excuse me. Where is the station?
This is a shop. This is a shirt.
